v5 is built and saved. Both decoders now have zero mean output on every reading code, so the constant offset is gone, and they are orthogonal to the z_head directions to about 1e-14. The pre-activations keep clean gate margins:

| Code | Drug-1 pair (units 114/10) | Drug-2 pair (units 0/107) |
|---|---|---|
| finger | on, about +12 (spread under 1) | off, about −52 |
| lab | off, about −14 | off, about −55 |
| arterial | off, about −70 | on, about +12 |
| cuff | off, about −70 | off, about −12 |

The decoded-dose noise per unit dose is 1.70 for drug 1 and 0.24 for drug 2, similar to v4.

The real test is the tool. A factual "both" pass on setA should show:
- if the offset was the cause of the v4 collapse: an edited NLL within a few thousandths of the original 1.519, with lab and cuff unchanged;
- if the replica's head inputs differ from the tool's in other ways: a large degradation again.
